(defprotocol NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x]))
(extend-type java.lang.Long NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :long))
(extend-type java.lang.Double NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :double))
(extend-type clojure.lang.BigInt NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :bigint))
(extend-type java.math.BigInteger NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :biginteger))
(extend-type clojure.lang.Ratio NumericClassProtocol (numeric-class-kind [x] :ratio))

(prn (mapv numeric-class-kind [1 1.0 1N (biginteger 1) 1/2 2 2.0 2N (biginteger 2) 2/3]))
(prn [(satisfies? NumericClassProtocol 1) (satisfies? NumericClassProtocol 1.0) (satisfies? NumericClassProtocol 1N) (satisfies? NumericClassProtocol (biginteger 1)) (satisfies? NumericClassProtocol 1/3) (satisfies? NumericClassProtocol nil)])
(prn (let [f (fn [x] (numeric-class-kind x))] [(f 1) (f 1.0) (f 1N) (f (biginteger 1)) (f 1/3) (f 2) (f 2.0)]))
stdout:

[:long :double :bigint :biginteger :ratio :long :double :bigint :biginteger :ratio]
[true true true true true false]
